name: 07675 · Westwood, NJ
findings: ZIP 07675 (Westwood) has 138 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07675 (Westwood) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07675 (Westwood) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
